background:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production raster asset for a Godot 2D western harbor shop, 1600x900 logical 16:9. Input is the approved harbor shop screenshot. Keep the exact overall perspective, port scenery, muted teal water, dock ropes and barrels, large wooden cargo sailing ship on the LEFT, pale warm harbor architecture, tan awning, afternoon natural daylight and the existing rich matte hand-painted western 2D style. This asset is the EMPTY ENVIRONMENT ONLY, to sit behind real interactive UI and separate character/product sprites.

REMOVE ALL text everywhere, all UI header/title/coins, all category signs, price tags, dialogue paper, checkout slip, all displayed liquor bottles, all merchant people/white-haired character and all selectable goods. Reconstruct naturally the portions of scenery previously hidden by those. NO letters or numbers or price labels. No characters. No merchandise bottles.

Maintain the right-side REAL wooden shelf cabinet with EMPTY two horizontal display planks. Its bounds occupy x=700..1580 and y=180..730 in the logical 1600x900 image. Set shelf top display standing surface at y=430, second surface at y=682. The wooden backboards are subdued dark warm brown to support colorful translucent game bottle sprites. Straight front-facing shelves, bases can sit firmly on straight lines. Shelf interior has NO crates, ropes or random objects where products will stand, keep shelf display bays clean and unobstructed. Only restrained crates/rope at far edges, iron braces and brass nail details. Leave x720..1560,y110..180 as a blank plain wooden lintel for real category labels. Shelf lower lip y740..880 is plain wooden counter suitable for a runtime paper purchase slip; DO NOT render the paper.

Left side behind the merchant's position x100..670 is harbor stall space with room for a separately composited character. Keep the left foreground shop counter horizontal at logical y740 and below across x0..700, with attractive matte worn wood and a few unobtrusive blank receipts at far corner, but no interface paper. Preserve the OFF, unlit brass lantern far lower-left: neutral glass, no flame or glow. Above y95 keep normal sky, canvas and wood scene, no UI header (actual UI header added at runtime). No border, no watermarks, no modern objects. The final image must look like a cohesive naturally staged realistic game shop environment, NOT a screenshot with erased rectangles. Matte painterly, subdued highlights, ambient daylight. ONE opaque 16:9 landscape empty background.
npc: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Production transparent sprite for Godot western 2D harbor shop. Input is approved shop screenshot. Create ONE isolated transparent-background character of the SAME white-haired young adult woman merchant shown in the LEFT of that screenshot. Preserve recognizable face, silver-white loose side braid over her left shoulder, warm gentle expression, cream linen rolled sleeve shirt, teal neckerchief, fitted practical brown leather vest, tan work apron, waist belt and pouch, bronze compass brooch. Keep same softly painted matte 2D western watercolor/gouache style, natural unglossy materials and diffuse daylight. Match the torso posture: one hand holds a folded cargo receipt to her right side (viewer right), other hand rests down in a natural counter-ready gesture. Reproduce complete upper body INCLUDING both hands and belt, continue to upper thighs with plain dark trousers, full silhouette unobstructed, no countertop or environmental objects. The NPC will be drawn behind a foreground counter later. Keep body front facing with slight turn, proportioned as the reference. Character is a young ADULT, practical modest western clothes. No names/text on receipt, no new accessories, no weapons. No background, no ground, no floor, no counter, no frame, no fake checkerboard. TRUE transparent RGBA alpha. Enough padding around hair and fingertips. ONE character only, composition vertical centered, high resolution, solid clean cutout edges.
